concepts.content: Use statistical ML for simple, structured features (tables, structured data). Use deep learning for complex, unstructured features (images, video, audio, text). Consider data volume: deep learning performs better with large training sets. These are loose guidelines; experimentation is required.

concepts.content: Feed‑forward neural network: information flows from input through hidden layers to output with no loops. Recurrent neural network (RNN): includes feedback loops, processing data over time dimensions. Transformer: the primary architecture behind modern generative AI models such as GPT, described as a generic architecture that powers these systems.
